description: This file contains a custom Android View implementation for rendering and managing the gameplay of a classic Snake game, including game logic, rendering, and user input handling.

classes.name: SnakeGameView
classes.description: Custom View class that encapsulates the rendering and game logic for the snake game in Android.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and starts a new game session.

methods.name: setDirection
methods.description: Sets the snake's movement direction based on user input, preventing illegal reversals.

methods.name: placeFood
methods.description: Places food at a random position on the grid that is not occupied by the snake.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates cell size and offsets when the view size changes.

methods.name: moveSnake
methods.description: Advances the snake in the current direction, handles collision detection and eating food.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles all the drawing of the game board, snake, food, and game over text.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles swipe gestures to change the snake's direction.
